Financial Planning Analyst, Internship

Employer: Aldergrove Capital Partners
Location: Winnipeg, MB
Work Model: Hybrid
Work Term: Summer 2027
Contract Length: 4 months
Salary: $62,000 - $68,000 per year
Closing Date: 2027-03-19

Overview

Aldergrove Capital Partners is an independent advisory firm serving mid-market clients.
The Financial Planning Analyst intern will support budgeting and forecasting cycles.

Responsibilities

- Build and maintain financial planning models
- Support quarterly budgeting and variance reporting
- Prepare materials for treasury and cash-flow reviews

Qualifications

- Enrolled in a finance, economics, or commerce program
